lines: It took the moment cleanly. Good gear is quiet until the blow lands.
It did the job when <dark_gray><wavy>fear</wavy></dark_gray> was loud. That's praise enough.
Good gear earns trust the moment trouble tests it.
Let me see that. The straps and plates tell a story if you know where to look.
Keep your shield ready. Most people notice damage after it matters.
